verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent schema. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file points to Markdown mirrors of the API reference, an MCP docs server, and an SDK-versions JSON file, but these are machine-readable docs, not a formal API spec, so they count only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
